text:
andrew.support: customer (acct: acme-corp) reports the streaming API connection drops mid-response when they're behind a corporate proxy. they see a ~10s silence then a TCP RST and partial JSON chunk. any quick thoughts?

maria-eng: do we have their proxy vendor? sounds like proxy is buffering then killing idling socket. could be tcp keepalive or proxy http/1.1 chunk handling.

andrew.support: they said 'BlueGate Proxy 4.2' (corporate appliance). attaching sample log from client: 
```
SSE chunk: data: {"id":1,"delta":"hello
"}
(data stops for ~10s)
socket reset by peer
partial JSON received
```

sam-cs: customer attached a short pcap too. saw TLS alerts before reset. packet capture snippet: 
```
... TLS Application Data (len=1024)
... (silent) 10s ...
TLS Close Notify or RST
```

raj-netops: that vendor is known to do deep inspection and will buffer until it hits a higher threshold then tear down idle streams. could be their idle-flow timeout. are they using HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1 chunked?

andrew.support: their app is using chunked SSE over HTTP/1.1. they aren't sending explicit keepalive comments.

maria-eng: two angles: 1) server side keepalive/ping comments to keep the proxy from idling (send `: keepalive

` comment every 5s) 2) recommend client enable TCP/TLS keepalive and exponential reconnect on 5xx/ECONNRESET. also consider moving to HTTP/2 if proxy supports passthrough.

raj-netops: can we quickly verify if our edge is not pausing writes? ask customer for an nginx access log and the exact request headers (Expect, Connection, Proxy-Authorization).

andrew.support: asked for headers and nginx logs, sent link to upload. also asked for exact OS and mobile carrier (they're on corp WiFi).

sam-cs: customer asked if they'll be billed for the partial chunk they received. answered: billing counts completed tokens; partial aborted responses should not be charged for incomplete generation tokens — escalated to billing to confirm, but product note: we should log aborted streams separately. :money_with_wings:

maria-eng: small repro I ran locally vs a basic proxy: added server-side comment ping `: "+
"` every 4s, issue disappeared for me. config snippet: 
```
// pseudo
setInterval(() => res.write(`: 
`), 4000)
```

raj-netops: if customer cannot change proxy, suggest adding server-side frequent comments as a compatibility shim. also capture `tcpdump -w` and share. I'll reach out to BlueGate support re: idle-flow timeout defaults.

andrew.support: next steps: 1) customer to run our shim (we provided small node snippet) and confirm, 2) provide nginx/access headers + pcap, 3) if shim fixes, mark workaround; if not, open vendor case. assigning to maria-eng to own server-side shim patch.

maria-eng: I'll prepare a tiny middleware we can drop into the streaming handler and a short KB note for support. will post PR link when ready.

support-bot: Reminder: Created ticket #SUP-2024-819 for this escalation and added `billing` and `network` tags.

andrew.support: thanks all — will follow up with customer once we have logs. :thumbsup:
